lucy: ran into a nasty repro: async client retries after a transient 5xx and re-sends an already-exhausted async generator -> server creates duplicate resource.
omar: can you paste the tiny repro?
lucy: minimal:
```py
async def stream_items():
  for i in range(5):
    await asyncio.sleep(0.2)
    yield b'{"i":%d}' % i

async for r in client.tasks.create_stream(stream_items(), retry=RetryConfig(max_attempts=3)):
  handle(r)
```
If token refresh happens mid-stream the retry machinery re-dispatches the same generator object. generator is partially consumed -> bad replay.
kevin: I thought we auto-add idempotency tokens for writes?
lucy: only for sync bytes bodies. async iterators skip header and yet retry still fires. bug: transparent retry should not happen for unseekable bodies.
rahul: proposal: 1) treat async iterators as non-replayable by default and skip transparent retries; 2) add RetryConfig.replay_mode = Enum(AUTO, NEVER, BUFFERED, EXPLICIT_TOKEN) where AUTO -> NEVER for async iterators; 3) provide utils.rewindable_async(it, max_bytes) helper that buffers up to N bytes then becomes replayable; 4) add telemetry events: retry.skip_unseekable, replay.buffered_used.
omar: typing issue too: endpoints annotated AsyncIterator[str] but yield bytes. we should standardize to AsyncIterator[bytes] for binary streams and update stubs. include deprecation warnings.
kevin: sample opt-in usage for buffered replay in quickstart please. also add a clear error when buffer overflows instructing users to add idempotency header.
ci-bot: ticket INF-4399 created: "async-retry-unseekable-safety" priority=high. PR draft by lucy: draft/feat/retry-rewindable (#6188).
rahul: I'll draft the RFC for RetryConfig + typing changes. will ping for review.
lucy: added an integration test that simulates token refresh during stream; it fails on main and passes with buffered shim.
ci-bot: merging blocked: security review required for buffering behavior.
